verdict.rationale: npm is itself the official CLI, maintained at github.com/npm/cli. Its first-party docs cover the core commands (install, search, ls, publish, link, adduser), global mode, and non-interactive configuration through NPM_CONFIG_ environment variables and --key val switches, so it can be scripted by agents. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented features such as machine-readable/JSON output or non-interactive auth, and independent hands-on corroboration of use in AI-agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
